subject.title: San Francisco Community College Board, Partial Term

text: The Community College Board is the seven-member governing body of the San Francisco Community College District. It

Trustee, City College of
San Francisco.

I’m running to keep City College accessible and affordable for everyone. I grew up in a small town where community college opened every door for me and my family, carrying me to a four-year university and a master’s degree in public policy from UC Berkeley.

City College is where people go to transform their lives, earn a debt-free degree or get better job training. That’s why I’m protecting Free City, growing enrollment and keeping the college financially stable.

Since joining the board in January, I’ve fought to restore funding and voted for a balanced budget. I’ve spent months listening to students, faculty and staff so their priorities shape what we do next.

I’ve spent my career fighting for students and workers, from tackling housing and student homelessness policy in the California Legislature to taking on the powerful in the State Capitol as a whistleblower and winning real accountability reforms.
I’m proof of what City College can do, and I’m proud to now do that work on the Board of Trustees.

Endorsements include:
Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi
Mayor Daniel Lurie
State Senator Scott Wiener
Assemblymember Matt Haney
Board of Supervisors President Rafael Mandelman
Supervisor Bilal Mahmood
Supervisor Myrna Melgar
Supervisor Danny Sauter
Supervisor Stephen Sherrill
Supervisor Alan Wong
City College Trustee Heather McCarty
City College Trustee Luis Zamora
